newsitem.title: USA: Unitel Video to merge West Coast facilities.
newsitem.headline: Unitel Video to merge West Coast facilities.

text.p: Unitel Video Inc said Tuesday it plans to merge its United/Hollywood and Editel/LA facilities, bringing its West Coast operations under one roof.
Unitel said it is taking the step so it can fill the void for a full service post production facility in Hollywood. It said the merged facility will be housed in Editel/LA's operations in Hollywood.
Unitel said it plans to add several new resources at the merged facility, including its third and fourth digital compositing suites and a second computer graphics workstation.
It said it was also moving ahead with plans to create high-speed intranet connection with Unitel Interactive in new York, to facilitate work in interactive media.
